answer_1.quote: perform text editing operations for three popular tasks: Grammatical Error Correction, Paraphrasing, and Text Simplification
answer_1.outputs: Edited texts for grammatical error correction, paraphrasing, and text simplification

answer_2.quote: For GEC evaluation, we follow prior work ... and use the MaxMatch (M2) Scorer, ERRANT, and GLEU ... For simplification, we ... use SARI and BLEU ... For paraphrasing ... use Self-BLEU ... and Semantic Similarity ... Specifically, we use mUSE

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations of our model outputs by proficient linguists (and native language speakers of the respective languages) on 50 test inputs (per task-language) ... asked to rate the quality of the output on three criteria: fluency ... adequacy ... and accuracy
answer_4.guideline: expert human annotators rate the system output on a Likert scale from Very Bad to Very Good for fluency (Is the output grammatically correct and sound like it was written by a native speaker?), adequacy (does the output preserve the meaning of the input?), and accuracy (did the model make the desired edits according to the given edit instructions?)
